topics.label: Introduction to cancer evolution and microenvironmental influences
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the aims, context, and key themes of the lecture on cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic clonal selection and epigenetic mechanisms in tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cells acquire competitive advantages and transform through sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell hierarchy in tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine whether cancers initiate from tissue-specific stem cells versus progenitor cells across hematological and intestinal models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental, stromal, and inflammatory promotion of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions are required for tumor outgrowth and malignancy.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for analyzing tumor biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews sequencing, spatial transcriptomic, and proteomic techniques used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions in the laboratory.

topics.label: Synthesis of multi-factorial cancer evolution and lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics summarise the combined roles of mutations, cell origin, and microenvironmental factors in cancer development before closing the lecture.
